Work / Print Shop Suite

Our product

Print Shop Suite

Three offline tools for print shops: ID cards back to back, passport photo sheets, and printing from phones.

See the product →Try CNIC Duplex →
Context
Havlen product
Type
Offline desktop and browser tools
Stack
JavaScript, Electron, Python (IPP, eSCL, Bonjour)
Status
Available for shops in Pakistan

The problem

Photocopy shops print ID cards and passport photos all day. Lining the back of a card up with the front by hand wastes paper, and getting files from a customer's phone to a USB printer is slow.

What we built

CNIC DuplexUp to eight cards per sheet at exact size, fronts and backs aligned. Calibrate once per printer.
QuickPrintPassport, visa and CNIC photos on 4×6 or A4 at true size, as a 300 DPI PDF.
Print BridgeCustomers print from their phone to the shop's USB printer over Wi-Fi.
Works offlineEverything runs on the shop's own Windows PC.

How it works

CNIC Duplex and QuickPrint lay sheets out in real millimetres and export PDFs locked to actual size. Print Bridge turns a Windows PC into a network printer phones understand (IPP and eSCL), with a simple web page as a fallback.

Status, honestly

Available to print shops in Pakistan. CNIC Duplex also runs free in any browser.
